items.label: Daily Drawdown Limit
items.detail: Of previous day's closing balance. Resets daily at 17:00 NY Time. Static.

items.label: Max Overall Drawdown
items.detail: Of initial balance. Static for account lifetime. Breach = immediate closure.

items.label: Min Profitable Days
items.detail: Minimum 2 profitable days (≥ 0.5% each) required per phase.

items.label: Notional Volume
items.detail: Limit varies by account size. Breach = Soft Breach.

items.label: Trade Consistency
items.detail: After 30 days funded, trade count and volume per instrument must stay within ±25% of baseline averages from challenge + first 30 funded days.

items.label: Quarterly Profit Target
items.detail: Rolling 90-day profit target of 5% of initial capital. Breach = downgrade to standard 2-Step funded (salary and 100% split revoked).

items.label: Hard Breach
items.detail: Daily or max drawdown violation. No recovery.

items.label: Soft Breach – Challenge
items.detail: Must return to positive balance before reset. 5 soft breaches = account closure. All cleared on reaching funded status.

items.label: Soft Breach – Funded
items.detail: Each breach reduces next payout by 10%. 5 breaches = account closure.

items.label: Consistency/Quarterly Breach
items.detail: Breach of consistency rule or quarterly target = automatic downgrade to standard funded. Salary and 100% split are revoked.

items.label: Profit Split
items.detail: Starts at 80%. Reaches 100% on 30th funded day (if in profit).

items.label: Salary
items.detail: Paid daily from first funded day. Accrues regardless of trading profit.

items.label: Payout Cycle
items.detail: On-demand after 2 min profitable days, then weekly.

items.label: Fee Refund
items.detail: Challenge fee refunded on 30th funded day if account is in profit.
